ana: Heads-up: while onboarding redwood-aurora-16k-q2_k on canary I hit a reproducible KV-cache coherence issue during long-document QA. Looks like RoPE anchoring drifts after ~9k tokens when using overlapped prefill chunks.
peter: can you share the minimal repro?
sasha: and model id?
ana: model=redwood-aurora-16k-q2_k, tokenizer=v4. Repro: two clients, staggered prefill windows with small overlap. Script: 
```
python tools/repro_interleave.py --model redwood-aurora-16k-q2_k --clients 2 --prefills "8192,6144" --overlap 512 --max-tokens 10000
```
after ~9200 tokens one client shows semantic collapse; runtime emits a small kv_index delta and a rope_anchor_misaligned.
Trimmed log: 
```
[2026-09-11T13:05:02Z] s=cliA PREFILL done base=0 len=8192 kv_idx=8192 fp=0x1a2b3c
[2026-09-11T13:05:03Z] s=cliB PREFILL done base=7680 len=6144 kv_idx=7677 fp=0x1a2b39
[2026-09-11T13:05:03Z] WARN kv_index_delta layer=12 delta=-15
[2026-09-11T13:05:03Z] ERROR rope_anchor_misaligned token_pos=9216 phase_shift=4
```
ana: Single-client runs clean. If I set runtime::rotary_disable=true the error goes away.
pet er: so rotary math + quant combo. Did you try forcing serialized prefill?
ana: runtime::prefill_serialized=true removes the flake too. So concurrency window required.
sasha: could be allocator race or remap arithmetic flipping sign under interleaved writes. Q2_k quantization seems to amplify small sign errors into phase aliasing.
peter: please capture per-layer rotary residuals and KV fingerprints in the trace. Also run a numeric diff between q2_k and float32 rotary kernel on the failing trace.
ana: pushing trace to /staging/traces/1765432105/. Quick probe I ran: 
```
python -c "from runtime.inspect import dump_rot_residuals; print(dump_rot_residuals('aurora-16k-q2_k', pos=9200))"
```
output showed small per-layer residuals (~1e-6) but layer 12 had ~5e-6, which multiplied across layers could explain phase_shift=4.
ci-bot: @ana queued job 1765432105-rotary-diff on canary-4 :white_check_mark:
sasha: two tracks: 1) fix allocator/remap atomicity (CAS or per-slot lock) to prevent negative deltas when prefill completions race; 2) add numeric guard in runtime: if remap_step produces non-monotonic indices then compute rotary in float32 for affected layers.
peter: add a flaky CI test: run the repro script 300x under emulated interleaving to catch regressions.
ana: quick experiment: I changed the rotor multiply accumulator in q2_k path to int32 accumulate and local test failures dropped 10x. Not a proof but promising.
sasha: good find. If int32 accumulator helps, we can add targeted change to quant kernel or put the FP fallback for layers with residual>threshold.
ops-bot: @ana triggered job debug-1765432105 with worker=canary-4 :white_check_mark:
peter: please include per-client kv fingerprint + prefill completion ns timestamp in traces; that helps correlate races. Also record tokenizer boundary CRC to rule out seam shifts.
ana: noted. I'll open a short PR with failing test + trace and tag eng-runtime. For short-term mitigation we'll gate aurora-16k-q2_k on Dedicated until we confirm fix or add FP fallback.
sasha: agreed. If numeric diff proves rotary kernel under q2_k is root cause we should add a runtime metric that counts remap_vs_fp mismatches and trigger automatic rollback for canary if rate > threshold.
a na: thanks team. I'll update when I have deterministic single-thread interleaved repro and the numeric diff results. :mag:
